attempts.summary: Installed httpd on node1, deployed an inventory application at /var/www/inventory (correctly labeled httpd_sys_content_t), configured Apache to listen on TCP 8181 via /etc/httpd/conf.d/inventory.conf, added the SELinux port label (semanage port -m -t http_port_t -p tcp 8181) so enforcing mode permits the bind, opened firewalld for 8181, and enabled+started httpd. Verified the app serves over 8181 with SELinux enforcing and zero AVC denials. Completed the mandatory single-node (node1) restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline, issued `shutdown -r now`, polled until reconnect, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified enforcing mode, httpd active, port 8181 listening, and HTTP 200 content after reboot.
